summary: Keep discovery non-executing and defer rate-limited publication

delivery.outcome: Discover executable paths and distribution metadata without starting unknown programs; isolate ecosystem tests from host tools/services; preserve pending publication batches after API rate limits.
nonGoals: No attribution of real owner merges to the probe without causal evidence
No personal publication, browser fallback, approval fabrication or required gate removal
No deployment before independent source publication
No host program execution to query unknown version behavior

architecture.decision: Keep the existing independent publication adapter and transport its genuine remaining rate-limit delta from archived ticket-116. Replace CLI version processes with static package metadata and nullable versions for unknown binaries. Use deterministic local fixtures for tool/service tests.
architecture.rollback: Retain a prior independently approved immutable runtime for read-only operations; keep publication blocked if approved adapter configuration is unavailable.
